name: Select an efficient data structure
short_description: Select and justify a data structure for three access patterns under stated time and memory constraints.
self_assessment: I can select structures for three access patterns without help and justify each complexity tradeoff.
description: Select and justify a data structure for three access patterns under stated time and memory constraints. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Choose structures for lookup, ordering, and updates

builds_on.note: Symbolic reasoning supports expressing growth relationships.
